dct_title_s: GRID3 COD - Ituri - Geospatial Data Layers 20260611
dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD–Ituri Geospatial Data Layers 20260611 data package provides geospatial layers for Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, including: Settlement names Health facilities Health zones Health areas This data package supersedes the previous v8.0 GRID3 COD health areas, health facilities, health zones, and settlement names layers for Ituri Province only. It does not supersede versions of these layers for other provinces or geographies. This dataset may contain unintended omissions. It was developed under a compressed timeline to enable timely information sharing and to support teams engaged in emergency response efforts. Dataset citation: Center for Integrated Earth System Information Network (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Ituri - Geospatial Data Layers 20260611. New York: Columbia University. [URL here] Accessed [DAY MONTH YEAR]. Contacts and data queries: The authors welcome feedback on the data, including suggestions, reports of errors or omissions, difficulties using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please contact: info@ciesin.columbia.edu.
